name: unixsr-monorepo
description: UNIXSR: Unix Style Request — Axios with a Unix vocabulary HTTP client

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix js && (cd py && mypy unixsr usr)
scripts.test: node --test test/version.test.js && npm test --prefix js && (cd py && python3 -m unittest -v test_usr.py test_parity.py)
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix js && pnpm --prefix web build && (cd py && python3 -m build)
